title: Quiet-Loud in E

# Quiet-Loud in E

Quiet-loud rock in E at 120 BPM in 4/4, 24 bars that loop from the lead break's D5 and tom fill back into the intro's E. Loudness comes from amp gain and density rather than volume, with one gain per guitar track.

## Form

| Section | Bars | Chords | What happens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intro (crunch) | 1–4 | E / D A / E / D G A | "Chug-chug-STAB" riff in open position, full kit |
| Verse (clean) | 5–8 | E / D A / E / D G A | Same riff clean, cross-stick and soft hats |
| Pre-chorus (crunch, muted) | 9–12 | A / A / C / D | Palm-muted chugs on an A pedal, snare roll, kit drops out on the last beat |
| Chorus (high gain) | 13–20 | E5 C5 G5 D5 ×2 | Power chords double-tracked hard left and right |
| Lead break (high gain) | 21–24 | E5 C5 G5 D5 | Rhythm thins to hits under an E minor pentatonic lead |

## Tracks

| Track | Sound | Mix | Part |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Clean | Telecaster Bridge, Standard | L30 | Open strokes, verse |
| Clean Mute | Telecaster Bridge, Muted | L30 | Palm mutes, verse |
| Crunch | Telecaster Bridge, Standard, crunch amp | L30 | Open strokes, intro and pre-chorus |
| Crunch Mute | Telecaster Bridge, Muted, crunch amp | L30 | Palm mutes, intro and pre-chorus |
| High Gain L | Telecaster Bridge, Standard, high-gain amp | Hard left | Power chords, bars 13–24 |
| High Gain R | Telecaster Bridge, Standard, high-gain amp | Hard right | Looser double of L, a few ms late |
| High Gain Lead | Telecaster Bridge, Standard, high-gain amp | R15 | Pentatonic lead with bends, bars 21–24 |
| Bass | Electric Bass (pick) | Center | Riff roots, then root eighths |
| Drums | Power kit | Center | Kick locked to the chugs, fills at section ends |

## Notes

- Muted tracks use the Telecaster Muted preset for palm mutes. The open and muted tracks of one gain are one guitarist, so they never overlap.
- Every guitar track drops its expression (CC 11) to zero within 30 ms of a note-off and restores it at the next note, a note gate written as automation so the amp doesn't sustain between notes.
- The riff is E Mixolydian (I–♭VII–IV) and the chorus borrows E Aeolian (i–♭VI–♭III–♭VII). Thirds appear only in the clean and crunch sections.
- The lead bends D to E in bar 21 and A to B in bar 23, each held two beats.
